title: A note on a recent claimed proof of the irrationality of Catalan's constant
summary: The preprint arXiv:2609.04176 (Z.-W. Sun, 3 September 2026) claims a proof that Catalan's constant $G$ is irrational: it constructs for each $B$ a number $\hat q_B$ from weighted tails of the series and asserts that, if $G=a/q$, the integer $N_B=q^S H_B^{\min}\hat q_B$ satisfies $0<|N_B|<1$ for large $B$ (its Theorem 9.1). We report four exact computations. First, the printed proof of the rank theorem (Theorem 2.1) carries $T_i$ where its own recurrence requires $T_{i+1}$; the slip is repairable, and the statement is verified exactly at 44 parameter pairs with $S\le 4$, $B\le 30$.
